text_block_list.text: (Crash...)

Three days have passed since I was stranded on an uninhabited island. My meager supply
of water and food ran out long ago. My phone is still stubbornly showing no service.

I shouldn't have joined a deserted island tour just for a change of pace.
At the very least, I should've checked the return ferry schedule...

Regret comes too late. Mourning the radiant days with horsegirls
that might have been, I slowly close my eyes...

Suddenly, I heard someone's voice. I had no idea
who on earth it could be—but it was a warm, gentle tone.

I don't really get what happened, but you must've had it rough~. You're safe now~.
Here, have some water☆

She lifted me up and brought a cup to my lips. A giant frame encompassing all.
The sense of comfort she provided. I felt it by pure instinct. She must be—

After gulping down the water, a warm bowl of miso soup was offered next. As I eagerly
sipped it down, my hazy consciousness began to clear up—
Taking a closer look, the "goddess" was Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you sure drank that right up~.
I'm so glad I brought along some miso soup~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, that gave me quite a shock~.
Finding an academy Trainer collapsed on the beach and all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just radioed the ferry, so everything's gonna be fine~.
Let's head back to the academy together☆

I had actually seen her heartwarming smile quite recently. Specifically, at the
"Discipline Competition," where pre-debut horsegirls took center stage.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I have an announcement for everyone!
Truth is, this morning—I officially passed 180 cm tall~!
(Ooooh...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Since it's such a momentous day, I'm gonna give it my all today~!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All racers are loaded into the gates.
Discipline Competition, Turf 1200m—they're off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono just keeps on growing, huh?
Isn't she the tallest one in Tracen Academy by now?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
She might be. And she uses her physique so well, too...
I bet plenty of Trainers have their eyes on her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Toaaaa~~!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Hishi Akebono!
She crosses the line with ease, leaving a massive gap behind her!

The sight of her making a flashy charge across the finish line with huge, sweeping strides was unforgettable.
But why on earth was someone like her on a deserted island...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I came out here to gather kelp~. I'm good buddies with the fisherman uncle,
and he told me I could take whatever I wanted~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The kelp here makes super mineral-rich broth,
and it turns out so, so buono~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! You're super hungry, aren't you?
Since we're here, why don't I whip up some food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep☆ I brought cooking gear made for the outdoors♪
Come to think of it, there are wild greens too, right? Oh, I know. Let's make a seafood hot pot~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A piping hot seafood pot packed with rich fish and kelp broth!
...Just thinking about it is making my tummy rumble~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then, first step is building a fire~☆
With practiced hands, Hishi Akebono set up her cookware and started a fire—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hot-hot-hot! Ahaha, starting a fire really is tricky after all~.
—Oh, found a crab!
She swiftly filleted a huge fish she'd caught out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whew~. Smells so good~!
Makes you wanna toss some udon in at the end, doesn't it!
In no time at all, she had prepared a mouthwatering seafood hot pot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here you go☆ I'm sure it's gonna be super buono~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, yay~♪

I devoured the meal hungrily. When I looked up,
my eyes met Hishi Akebono's, who was watching me with a look of pure bliss.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buono?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Seeing someone enjoy their food so much really makes me happy~!
I've always wanted someone like that to be my Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Though whenever I tell that to the folks trying to scout me,
they just say, "I don't really get it."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So that's why I haven't been able to settle on a Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! I know! How about you~?
Won't you become my Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you become my Trainer, let's see...
I'll come make you miso soup every single day~!

Setting aside the daily miso soup—her powerful strides had left quite an impression on me,
and there was something captivating about her unique charm.
choice_data_list: (I want to see where her future leads)

text_block_list.text: With that thought crossing my mind, I nodded in agreement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Waah! Really?! Hooray~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad I came out here today~.
Looking forward to working with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! To celebrate tonight, I'll cook whatever dinner
is your absolute favorite~! What sounds good? What do you want~?

Swept up in her excitement, I blurted out my favorite food... and just like that,
my three-legged race of a partnership with Hishi Akebono abruptly began.
